text:
Situation: Dexmedetomidine hydrochloride has been on the FDA shortage list since 2020-04-10 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a span of 78 months. The FDA record shows multiple manufacturers with current status, including Accord Healthcare Inc. and Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. reporting discontinuation of manufacture, and Fresenius Kabi USA LLC with estimated recovery TBD. Corvale General holds approximately 483 units at 23.8 units per day (20 days on hand). Corvale East holds 104 units at 15.5 units per day (7 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 30 units (13 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2020-04-10. As of 2026-10-21 the list includes Accord Healthcare Inc. (discontinuation), Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Azurity Pharmaceuticals Inc., Baxter Healthcare, Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC (recovery TBD), Gland Pharma Limited, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., HQ Specialty Pharma, Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. (discontinuation), Jiangsu Hengrui Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd., and Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc.

Our position: Internal transfer is the fastest way to protect Corvale East without new procurement risk. Corvale General can spare 113 units and retain two weeks of supply; Corvale East would reach 14 days on hand. Avenacy Inc. and CIVICA INC. are not on the FDA shortage list today and are viable secondary sources.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute transfer of 113 units from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval.
2. Place purchase order with Avenacy Inc. (plant: HENGRUI PHARMA) — requires buyer approval.
3. Place purchase order with CIVICA INC. — requires buyer approval.
4. Place purchase order with Henry Schein, Inc. — requires buyer approval.
5. Place purchase order with Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC — requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: Delaying the transfer while awaiting new vendor deliveries; relying solely on Corvale Lakeside stock to cover Corvale East.
